name: Workflow 6: WhatsApp Re-engagement Campaign
description: Automatically identifies dormant customers (60+ days since last purchase) and runs a win-back sequence

setup_instructions.step_1: Ensure your Google Sheet 'Customers' has columns: phone, name, last_purchase_date, total_purchases, reengagement_sent
setup_instructions.step_3: Configure your WhatsApp API and Google Sheets credentials
setup_instructions.step_4: Update the offer details in message nodes
setup_instructions.step_5: Schedule to run every Monday at 9 AM Dubai time
setup_instructions.note: Only customers with explicit opt-in consent should be included in this campaign

text.body:
Hi {{$json.name}}! Long time no see 👋

It's [YOUR NAME] from [BUSINESS NAME].

We've been thinking about you and wanted to share something special before we announce it publicly.

We just launched [NEW PRODUCT/SERVICE/OFFER] and you get first access as a valued customer.

Interested? Reply YES and I'll send you the details right away! 😊

[YOUR NAME]

nodes.name: Wait 15 Days
nodes.description: Wait 15 days before sending the final message

text.body:
Hi {{$json.name}}! 😊

One final message, I promise!

We miss having you as an active customer and wanted to make it extra easy to come back.

🎁 Special returning customer offer (this week only):
[OFFER DESCRIPTION]
Normal price: AED [PRICE]
Your price: AED [DISCOUNTED_PRICE]

[BOOKING/SHOP LINK]

If you have feedback about why you haven't been back, I'd genuinely love to hear it — just reply here.

Either way, thank you for being a customer. It meant a lot to us! 🙏

Best,
[YOUR NAME]
[BUSINESS NAME]

P.S. Reply STOP if you'd prefer not to hear from us — completely understood!

notes: COMPLIANCE: Only run this on customers who explicitly opted in to marketing messages
ALWAYS include opt-out option: 'Reply STOP to unsubscribe'
UAE PDPL: Respect opt-out requests within 24 hours
Replace all [PLACEHOLDERS] with your actual business information
Test with your own phone number first
Monitor opt-out rate — if >5%, review message frequency and content
